import sys,time,random,json,resource
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission');sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps')
from common import validate
from planning import solve
R=int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 2048
O=int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 4096
P=int(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv)>3 else 32
NQ=4096; NOQ=4096
def forest(n):
 nodes=[]
 for i in range(n):
  if i%32==0: parent=None
  else: parent=f'n{i-1}'
  nodes.append({'id':f'n{i}','parent':parent,'capacity':4096})
 return nodes
rq=forest(NQ);oq=forest(NOQ)
leases=[{'id':'l','prefix':'2001:db8::/56','start':0,'end':10**12,'subnets':[0],'low_count':1}]
services=[{'id':'s','kind':'tcp'}]
random.seed(7)
reqs=[]
for i in range(R):
 target=f'2001:db8:{(i>>16)&0xffff:x}:{i&0xffff:x}::1'
 reqs.append({'id':f'r{i}','at':0,'lease':'l','target':target,'service':'s','group':f'n{(i*7)%NQ}'})
offers=[]
for j in range(O):
 listed=[]
 for k in range(P): listed.append(f'r{(j*37+k*127)%R}')
 offers.append({'id':f'o{j}','time':random.randrange(0,101),'service':'s','prefix':'2001:db8::/32','capacity':random.randrange(0,5),'cost':random.randrange(0,10**9),'group':f'n{(j*11)%NOQ}','requests':listed})
job={'version':3,'seed':'x','leases':leases,'services':services,'queries':[0],'captures':[],'requests':reqs,'offers':offers,'request_quotas':rq,'offer_quotas':oq}
t=time.time();ctx=validate(job);print('validated',time.time()-t,'pairs',sum(len(o['requests']) for o in offers))
active={f'r{i}':True for i in range(R)}
t=time.time();res=solve(ctx,active);print('solved',time.time()-t,'resolved',res['resolved'],'cost',res['cost'])
print('maxrss',resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss)
EOF
